verdict.rationale: Brex publishes per-API reference pages generated from OpenAPI specs (transactions, budgets, expenses, payments, webhooks). Runnable examples come through a Brex Postman developer workspace with collections for all its APIs, which is an external tool rather than an interactive in-docs console. Probes found no public OpenAPI JSON at the standard paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive 'try it' console, runnable code samples embedded in the reference, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
